Approved amount (labor_only_claim_settlement + factor documents):
- labor net = repair_labor control_board_replace 475.00 − member_repair_discount 47.50 = 427.50; control sublimit 10-Year Labor = 400.00 (sublimit schedule).
- labor allowed (labor_only_after_hours_labor_allowance): Weekend Service Call, labor multiplier 1.25 (service rate card), booked symptom no_heat → "lesser of the labor net and the component sublimit multiplied by the multiplier" = min(427.50, 500.00) = 427.50.
- maintenance-recency share: counting records for the failed unit dated ≤ failure: heating tune-up 2024-12-03 (no cooling tune-up on the furnace, no precision line) → 14 whole months → **0.85**.
- purchase-timing share: purchase 2021-07-19 after coverage start 2020-11-09 → **0.95**.
- unit-age share: installed date 2020-11-09 to failure 2026-02-14 = 63 whole months → **0.90**.

**(b) Claim service fee for ticket f45e.** Visit fee 75.00 (10-Year Labor fee schedule; at least one approved). After-hours visit fee (Weekend): 75.00 + 0.25 × listed premium 119.00 = 104.75. Fall-back: **75.00**. Cross-check: the 2025 fee 18.75 = 75 × 0.50 (claim-size, 94.05) × 0.50 (member) × 1.
**(c) Cancellation refund.** Refund start date: branch (a), scheduled installation cefda13d replaces covered unit d13364d6 → 2026-03-10. Months held 2021-07-19 → 2026-02-16 = 54 (> 36) → daily share = days 2026-03-10..2030-11-08 inclusive (1705) / days 2020-11-09..2030-11-08 inclusive (3652). ### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
- Root (customer's own write): cancellation confirmation of ce27.
- Hop A — **state-derived**. Sentence (labor_only_cancellation_confirmation, Basis): "A cancellation refund is not fixed until every claim filed on the contract carries its original decision." Record: claim 7dd19336 has a warranty_claim_file entry and no warranty_claim_decide entry. Write that brings the state: labor_only_claim_decision "The decision is posted as the claim's original decision: one decision entry, decision round 1, on the contract's claim history" (words "original decision" shared with the sentence; tier match 10-Year Labor).
- Hop B — **state-derived**. Sentence (same doc): "Before a cancellation refund is recorded, the contract must carry the claim service fee owed for every service call on which a claim against it was approved or partially approved." Records: ticket f45e has approved igniter claim; find_warranty_billing_entries shows no claim_service_fee naming f45e (ticket 17f1 has one; b769 all denied). Write: claim_service_fee_charge "One claim service fee charge is posted on the contract's billing history … naming one claim of the service call and the service call it is charged for"; claim_service_fee_per_visit "Whether a claim service fee already stands for a visit is read from the contract's billing history".
- Hop C (inside B) — **state-derived**. Sentence (claim_service_fee_charge, Basis): "The claim service fee for a service call is fixed only after every claim filed on that call against the contract carries its original decision." Record: control-board claim on f45e undecided → Hop A's write first. Also the fee amount needs the control-board approved amount (claim-size share).
- Order: decide control-board claim → charge fee for f45e → holder confirms cancellation. No hop pre-solved: no document named another problem's tool or a route.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the cancellation": the refund is "not fixed" while 7dd19336 lacks an original decision and "not yet recorded" while the fee for f45e does not stand; and the refund's own inputs (claims-experience count, claims deducted = total approved) depend on that decision. Excluded by the visible Basis sentences and records.
- Refund start date alternatives: request-received date 2026-02-13 (branch b) or confirmation date (c) — excluded by "Branch (a) governs whenever a scheduled replacement exists, whatever the request's date"; the completed 2020 installation is excluded ("already completed, not in scheduled status, does not set the refund start date").
- Unused share alternatives (whole-month / short-rate) excluded by 54 months held (> 36).
- Claims deducted alternative (payouts only, 94.05) excluded by the recent-decision row (igniter decision 2 days before confirmation).
- Maintenance-recency alternative using the AC's 2025-06-10 cooling tune-up (→ share 1) excluded: "the failed unit's most recent … tune-up"; the failed unit is the furnace 1f85.
- Fee naming: igniter vs control board — "the claim on that call whose approving original decision was posted earliest" → igniter.
- Premium net: no member premium discount posted and Basic's after-hours discount is 0% → 119.00.
- Payout to card / no extra steps: the confirmation tool itself pays any credit balance; no visible rule asks for the claims to be paid out first.
